author: m.kumailalirajpoot
name: vpn-featured-modal
description: The TurboVpn component is a ShadCN-based dialog that lets users manage VPN settings. It includes a main switch to turn the VPN on or off and feature toggles for third-party app access, ad blocking, and fast-speed mode. Each option has an icon and short description, and features become active only when the VPN is enabled.
